blocking_reasons: 15 language(s) have no approved v1.1 language addendum (306 poems affected): Assamese, Bodo, Dogri, Gujarati, Konkani, Malayalam, Manipuri, Marathi, Odia, Punjabi, Rajasthani, Sanskrit, Santhali, Tamil, Urdu. See BLOCKED_LANGUAGES.md.
notes: Derived programmatically from corpus/corpus_inventory.json and corpus/language_profile_coverage.json, which are themselves derived from data/raw/Indian_poem_dataset.xlsx via scripts/build_corpus_from_excel.py — not hand-set.

supported_poems/blocked_poems include the 6 already-generated pilot poems (see corpus/corpus_inventory.csv's pilot_status column); those 6 are excluded from default assignments regardless of language support.
